title: Observers’ Votes
description: Observers’ votes at AI Aesthetics: the votes cast across the ten volumes, for each designer and in total. Every rank here comes from observers.
lead: In every volume, each observer holds two votes for two different works and can take either back at any time. The ranks on this page come from observers’ votes alone.
